race.comment: COSMIC SPIRIT (6) disappointed last start at Pinjarra after a strong return effort. Pike reunites with the mare today as the blinkers go on for the first time. Expecting her to be better suited out in trip and now third-up after a long spell, she can start getting back to her best. ZEEZEA (2) was too good here a fortnight ago, winning well after jumping a $21 chance. Nottle rides now and she is a third-up winner in the past. Will need some luck from the draw, but she won't be far away if she can run up to her latest effort. CHOUX SHOE (1) finished behind ZEEZEA last start when 1.7L off the winner as the race favourite. Tsang's claim is a bonus and she should get every chance from the draw. Can feature in the finish again. GAV HAS SPOKEN (11) was impressive first-up and can be in the finish. ARTIE'S STORM (8) can feature third-up from the inside barrier.
